company.name: Computershare Ltd
company.description: Computershare Limited provides issuer, corporate trust, employee share plans, and other services. It offers issuer services, including register maintenance, corporate actions, stakeholder relationship management, and entity compliance and governance solutions; corporate trust services, including asset-backed securities, statutory trust, longevity, mortgage-backed securities, CLO and loan, business escrow, exchange, collateral trust, catastrophe bond, loan administration and agency, institutional custody, corporate finance, municipal debt, successor trustee, and collateral agency services; and property rental services, as well as childcare voucher administration services. The company also provides utility services; communication services for banks, credit unions, financial services providers, and commercial financing providers; transfer agent services, such as corporate actions, IPO and listing events, annual general meetings, alternative investments, capital solutions, global capital markets, and asset reunification services. In addition, it offers technology services; employee share plans and voucher services, including employee share plan solutions, share plan management services, trading, payment and nominee solutions, financial reporting, tax solutions, trustee services, and other administration and related services for employee share and option plans; and operations and shared services. The company operates in Asia, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, Continental Europe, the United Kingdom, the Channel Islands, Ireland, South Africa, and the United States. Computershare Limited was incorporated in 1978 and is based in Abbotsford, Australia.

company.name: CNPC Capital Co Ltd
company.description: CNPC Capital Company Limited provides financial services in China and internationally. It provides savings deposits, personal loans, bank cards, investment and wealth management, and credit cards; deposit settlement, traditional financing, investment banking, supply chain financing, and corporate credit; and international settlement, international trade finance, and foreign exchange business. The company also offers payment and collection, internal transfer settlement, bill acceptance and discounting; financial leasing, operating leasing and sale-leaseback; and asset servicing trust, asset management trust, and charitable trust. In addition, it provides property loss insurance, liability insurance, credit insurance, guarantee insurance, short-term health insurance, accident insurance, and reinsurance services, as well as life and investment-linked insurances, and group employee benefit plans. Further, the company engages in insurance brokerage, insurance loss assessment, and risk consulting; provision of risk reduction, claims investigation and inspection, loss assessment and settlement, residual value processing, marine claims settlement, and claims consulting; and corporate credit enhancement, credit product creation and trading, and asset investment. Additionally, it offers securities brokerage; securities investment consulting; financial advisory services related to securities trading and investment activities; securities underwriting and sponsorship; proprietary securities trading; securities asset management; margin trading; distribution of mutual funds and financial products; and management of publicly offered mutual funds, as well as services to futures companies. The company was formerly known as Jinan Diesel Engine Co., Ltd. and changed its name to CNPC Capital Company Limited in February 2017. The company was founded in 1996 and is based in Beijing, China. CNPC Capital Company Limited is a subsidiary of China National Petroleum Corporation.
